description: This file declares function types, dispatch mechanisms, and shape check functions for various pooling operations (2D and 3D, forward and backward) in the ATen/native namespace of PyTorch, including max and average pooling.

methods.name: safe_downcast
methods.description: Safely downcasts a source type to a destination type with range check.

methods.name: pooling_output_shape_pad_lr
methods.description: Calculates output shape for pooling with padding and stride.

methods.name: pooling_output_shape
methods.description: Calculates output shape for pooling with padding, stride, and dilation.

methods.name: _pooling_same_mode_padding_lr
methods.description: Calculates symmetric padding for same mode pooling.

methods.name: pooling_same_mode_padding_lr
methods.description: Returns padding for same mode pooling (int and SymInt versions).

methods.name: max_pool2d_backward_shape_check
methods.description: Checks shape validity for 2D max pooling backward pass.

methods.name: avg_pool2d_backward_shape_check
methods.description: Checks shape validity for 2D average pooling backward pass.

methods.name: max_pool3d_backward_shape_check
methods.description: Checks shape validity for 3D max pooling backward pass.

methods.name: avg_pool3d_backward_shape_check
methods.description: Checks shape validity for 3D average pooling backward pass.
